title: A bulk status change or Board drop overtakes an older queued check-off (MOD-561)

source.note: PR #642 landed the fix in two commits: WIP fe7c968 and a1623827; base is before both, the oracle comes from the second.

prompt: Bug (MOD-561): a person checks a task off while offline, comes back online, and while that check-off is still being sent they set the same task back to To do, either with a bulk status change in the Tasks list or by dropping it into the To do column on the Board. The task ends up Done: the bulk change and the Board drop send their status write straight away instead of waiting behind the older queued check-off, so the older write lands last. Make both paths wait their turn behind an older status write for the same task, and add regression tests. The code is in apps/app/src/features/tasks/commands/ and apps/app/src/lib/sync/. Don't commit or push.

checks.name: bulk and drop wait behind the check-off
